result.question: Quais diagnosticos tiveram maior aumento na taxa de mortalidade entre 2008-2012 e 2019-2023?
result.gold_sql: WITH p1 AS (SELECT "DIAG_PRINC" AS cid, COUNT(*) AS n1, SUM(CASE WHEN "MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m1 FROM internacoes WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") BETWEEN 2008 AND 2012 GROUP BY "DIAG_PRINC"), p2 AS (SELECT "DIAG_PRINC" AS cid, COUNT(*) AS n2, SUM(CASE WHEN "MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m2 FROM internacoes WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") BETWEEN 2019 AND 2023 GROUP BY "DIAG_PRINC") SELECT c."DESCRICAO" AS diagnostico, n1 AS internacoes_2008_2012, n2 AS internacoes_2019_2023, ROUND(m1 * 100.0 / NULLIF(n1, 0), 2) AS taxa_2008_2012, ROUND(m2 * 100.0 / NULLIF(n2, 0), 2) AS taxa_2019_2023, ROUND((m2 * 100.0 / NULLIF(n2, 0)) - (m1 * 100.0 / NULLIF(n1, 0)), 2) AS aumento_pontos_percentuais FROM p1 JOIN p2 ON p1.cid = p2.cid JOIN cid c ON p1.cid = c."CID" WHERE n1 >= 1000 AND n2 >= 1000 ORDER BY aumento_pontos_percentuais DESC LIMIT 10;
result.generated_sql: WITH taxa_mortalidade_2008_2012 AS ( SELECT c."DESCRICAO" AS diagnostico, SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS taxa_mortalidade FROM internacoes i JOIN cid c ON i."DIAG_PRINC" = c."CID" WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") BETWEEN 2008 AND 2012 GROUP BY c."DESCRICAO" ), taxa_mortalidade_2019_2023 AS ( SELECT c."DESCRICAO" AS diagnostico, SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS taxa_mortalidade FROM internacoes i JOIN cid c ON i."DIAG_PRINC" = c."CID" WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") BETWEEN 2019 AND 2023 GROUP BY c."DESCRICAO" ) SELECT t1.diagnostico, (t2.taxa_mortalidade - t1.taxa_mortalidade) AS aumento_taxa_mortalidade FROM taxa_mortalidade_2008_2012 t1 JOIN taxa_mortalidade_2019_2023 t2 ON t1.diagnostico = t2.diagnostico ORDER BY aumento_taxa_mortalidade DESC LIMIT 1;
